name: ApplicationPath
label: Application path
description: The path to the application or document to execute.

name: CommandLineArguments
label: Command line arguments
description: Optional command-line arguments to pass to the application.

name: WorkingFolder
label: Working folder
description: The working directory for the application.

name: WindowStyle
label: Window style
description: Specifies how the application window should be displayed.

selectOptions.label: Normal
selectOptions.description: The window is shown in normal size and position.

selectOptions.label: Minimized
selectOptions.description: The window is displayed as a minimized window.

selectOptions.label: Maximized
selectOptions.description: The window is displayed as a maximized window.

name: AfterApplicationLaunch
label: After application launch
description: Specifies the behavior after launching the application.

selectOptions.label: Continue Immediately
selectOptions.description: Continue workflow execution immediately after launching the application.

selectOptions.label: Wait for Application to Load
selectOptions.description: Wait until the launched application has fully loaded before continuing.

selectOptions.label: Wait for Application to Complete
selectOptions.description: Wait until the launched application has exited before continuing.

name: Timeout
label: Timeout
description: The maximum time (in seconds) to wait for the application to complete.

name: AppProcessId
label: AppProcessId
description: The process ID of the launched application.

name: AppExitCode
label: AppExitCode
description: The exit code of the application if it completes.

name: StatusMessages
label: Status Message
description: Provides status information about the operation.
